Current letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

When I came across the Frontend Engineer opening at Bright Labs, I knew I wanted to apply. The focus of the position fits my experience well. I currently work as Frontend Engineer at Nimbus for over 5 years.

I noticed you value React, TypeScript and GraphQL; these have been core to my recent work. Built and maintained a component library used by 12 product teams; improved Lighthouse performance scores by 35% and led accessibility remediation to WCAG 2.1 AA. My background includes B.S. Computer Science from UC Berkeley.

I'd love to talk about how my background fits your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Aaliyah Huang

Return only the rewritten letter.

Dear Hiring Manager,

I was genuinely excited to see the Frontend Engineer opening at Bright Labs. Building accessible, high-performance React interfaces is exactly the work I care most about, and the idea of doing it on analytics tools that thousands of teams rely on is a strong pull for me.

Much of what you describe mirrors my day-to-day. At Nimbus I built and maintained the component library that twelve product teams depended on, so owning and evolving a design system end to end is familiar territory. I work in TypeScript by default and partner closely with product and design to take features from idea to ship.

Your emphasis on accessibility and performance is where I do some of my best work. I led our WCAG 2.1 AA remediation so the whole product met the standard, and I raised our Lighthouse performance scores by 35% through focused profiling and code-splitting. I'm also comfortable wiring up GraphQL APIs, which lines up with your stack.

I'd welcome the chance to bring that same focus on quality and inclusive design to Bright Labs. Thank you for considering my application, and I'd love to talk more about how I can help your team.

Sincerely,
Aaliyah Huang
